title: 第10章 家三第11章 木佛寺一
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
“方才那鬼东西用黑发缠上自己，却没有浮现任何技能提示。是因为那只是幻觉，还是说那东西本就没有实体？
又或者，是自己还有什么隐藏条件，无法下载这种东西的技能？”
种种念头在胡隆脑海中一闪而过。
可惜目前的信息有限，根本无法确定正确原因。
他不再多想，收回心神，目光落向面前的桌子。
桌面上并没有多少多余的东西。
只有一台崭新的电脑和一部手机，屏幕上的保护膜还未撕去。
桌角贴着一张浅色的便利贴，上面留着一行娟秀的字迹：
“爱你的爸爸妈妈。”
这大概是原身母亲留下的。
胡隆拿起手机，撕掉覆膜，简单设置后随手试了试。
接着，他又掀开电脑，按下开机键。
无论是手机还是电脑，操作方式都与前世并无太大差别。
加上原身本就拥有‘大师级网络攻防’的技能。
胡隆用起这些设备来，没有丝毫生疏，反而透着一股行云流水般的熟练。
他轻车熟路地打开浏览器，点进常去的贴吧，在搜索栏里敲下几个关键的字词。
……
啪嗒……啪嗒……
窗外细雨如纱，雨丝绵密，从二楼望出去，能看见檐角的水珠正一滴一滴往下坠。
那水滴先落在二楼伸出的瓦檐边沿，悬着、颤着，攒足了分量，便直直地落下去。

然后不偏不倚，正打在下方一楼那层更宽些的坡檐青瓦上。
远处，灰白色的建筑如同波浪，层层叠叠，每一处园林别墅都像是一个独立的庄园，在雨雾之中别有一番风味。
随着时间的推移。
墙壁上的时钟滴答滴答的走着。
窗外的雨声渐渐小了下去。
“果然，还是没有什么有用的信息！”
半晌。
胡隆靠在躺椅后背，有些头疼的伸手捏了捏眉心。
刚才他搜索的结果不出意外，并不尽人意。
倒不是网上什么都没有。
恰恰相反。
网上各种的信息很多，不过太过驳杂，类似他这般，遭遇到诡异的事情并不少。
但是在胡隆看来，其中多数都是编撰的故事，或者从老一辈听来的神秘传说。
当成故事听还算不错，但是仔细推敲，就会发现其中的漏洞并不少。
要不就是一些根本无法分辨真假的事情。
根本没有太大的参考性。
他甚至动用了一些非常规手段，试图入侵某些官方信息库，查清自己身上出现的问题。
按理说，这类异常情况官方理应有记录才对。
content_en:
"That ghost thing just wrapped its black hair around itself, but no skill prompt appeared. Is it because it was just an illusion, or does it have no entity in the first place?
Or, do you have any hidden conditions that prevent you from downloading such a skill? "
All kinds of thoughts flashed through Hu Long's mind.
Unfortunately, the current information is limited and it is impossible to determine the correct cause.
He stopped thinking about it, withdrew his mind and looked at the table in front of him.
There's not a lot of extra stuff on the table.
There is only a brand new computer and a mobile phone, the protective film on the screen has not yet been removed.
There is a light-colored post-it note stuck to the corner of the table, with a line of beautiful handwriting on it:
"Love you mom and dad."
This was probably left by the original mother.
Hu Long picked up the phone, peeled off the film, briefly set it up and tried it out.
Then, he opened the computer again and pressed the power button.
Whether it is a mobile phone or a computer, the operation method is not much different from the previous life.
In addition, he already possesses the skills of "master-level network attack and defense".
When Hu Long used these equipment, he was not unfamiliar at all, but showed a smooth flow of proficiency.
He opened the browser with familiarity, clicked into the post bar he often visited, and typed in a few key words in the search bar.
…
Click... click...
The drizzle outside the window is like gauze, and the rain is dense. Looking out from the second floor, you can see the water drops falling drop by drop on the corners of the eaves.
The water droplets first landed on the edge of the tile eaves protruding from the second floor. They hung and trembled. After gathering enough weight, they fell straight down.
Then it hit the wider sloping eaves of the green tiles on the first floor below without leaning to one side.
In the distance, the gray-white buildings are like waves, layer upon layer. Each garden villa is like an independent manor, with a unique flavor in the rain and fog.
over time.
The clock on the wall was ticking.
The sound of rain outside the window gradually became smaller.
"Sure enough, there is still no useful information!"
A long while.
Hu Long leaned on the back of the recliner and pinched his eyebrows with a headache.
The results of his search just now were not surprising, but not satisfactory.
It’s not that there’s nothing online.
Quite the opposite.
There is a lot of information on the Internet, but it is too complicated. People like him have encountered many strange things.
But in Hu Long's opinion, most of them are made-up stories or mysterious legends heard from the older generation.
It sounds good as a story, but if you think about it carefully, you will find that there are many loopholes in it.
Or it’s something that is impossible to distinguish between true and false.
Not much reference at all.
He even used some unconventional means to try to invade some official information databases to find out what was wrong with him.
It stands to reason that there should be official records of such abnormal situations.
